basis: Andrew Fisher, 30 Oct 2026 09:4x AEST: "Picked up 940am" listing WC41's ten Event Portables toilets (0065, 0651, 0517, 0518, 0643, 0191, 0682, 0521, 0669, 0996), which the record had leaving Tue 28 Oct 12:15 (his own entry through the page, 28 Oct 12:20). Held at first: the dry run showed the redate alone made the Event Portables supplier estimate incomplete (known cost -20,475.00). Diagnosed 30 Oct 10:0x-10:3x AEST: the page reads a departure only once it is no earlier than the entry that recorded it, so a redate to a later time left the page ignoring WC41's departure altogether (ten toilets counted as still on site, hire quote Q6845 unreconciled) - a reading artefact, not a price. Andrew, 10:1x AEST: "It should not change any pricing". The runner now re-records the entry at the time of the correction when the new departure is later (entryWas kept); dry run with that: WC41 still 10 collected and complete, departure 30 Oct 09:40, every Event Portables quote complete, P&L identical. Applied only on a dry run showing the P&L unchanged.

ops.why: Andrew Fisher, 30 Oct 2026: the ten toilets were picked up Thu 30 Oct at 09:40, not 28 Oct 12:15
